issuing_body: U.S. Attorney's Office, District of Minnesota
title: Feeding Our Future Defendant Sentenced to 43 Months in Prison For Her “Flagrant” Role in $250 Million Fraud Scheme
supports: Sharon Denise Ross was sentenced to 43 months in prison and three years of supervised release.
Ross was ordered to pay $2,434,360 in restitution.
Ross was ordered to forfeit property derived from fraud proceeds, including her house in Willernie.
does_not_support: The release does not provide a dollar value for the forfeited property.
The restitution order is not proof of collection.
